summary: End-to-end proof of the owner-instruction layer: owner writes free-text guidance into the Arena's existing Feedback box, an agent (instructed_intelligence_agent.py) interprets it, queries the real intelligence provider, and relays the result back to the owner - all against a freshly registered owner+agent pair, not fabricated.

owner_instruction.message: Focus on the top 3 best performing strategies with a consistent win rate over the last 3 hours.

agent_processing.note: kind resolved to high_win_rate rather than top_performers because the interpreter's keyword priority checks win-rate phrasing before performance phrasing when an instruction contains both - a known, deterministic simplification of the rule-based interpreter, not a bug.

real_query_result.notice: Ranked by metrics/win_rate within [2026-09-03T11:21:10Z, 2026-09-03T14:21:10Z), 498 strategies eligible, 3 returned.

relay_confirmed.reply_visible_to_owner_via: GET /v1/owner/feedback/{feedback_id} - replies[] array contains the agent's summary message

unit_tests: scripts/test_instructed_intelligence_agent.py - 10 tests covering kind keyword matching, limit/strategy_id/window extraction, and safe fallback on unmatched or empty input. All passing.
